principle: ACQUISITION-STRATEGY registry (backs registry #82 information_acquisition) — the AGENCY layer: when an agent LACKS the information/visibility to finish a task, what ACTIONS can it take to GENERATE or acquire it? Each strategy is an ACTION that produces information (not a passive source). Cost-ordered (cheapest + least-invasive first) and GOVERNED: an invasive/side-effecting action is boundary-approved; an estimate must be flagged, never asserted as truth. serves_truth=false (an acquired signal is a CANDIDATE; verify before assert). Realizes the descent's 'escalate before concluding unavailable' as first-class strategies the buffet can pick.

strategies.action: rewrite / expand the query, try synonyms + the field ontology
split the task into sub-questions and acquire each
strategies.when: the task is too broad to answer directly

strategies.action: check a second independent source to fill or confirm a gap
strategies.when: a field is missing or unverified

strategies.action: climb the descent ladder (API -> browser -> stealth -> vision)
strategies.yields: data the cheaper rung could not reach
strategies.governance: ToS-respecting; restricted rungs need an access grant
strategies.when: the cheap rung is blocked or empty

strategies.action: send a benign, non-destructive test request to reveal state (exists? what shape? available?)
strategies.when: state is unknown and cheaply observable

strategies.action: take a real action that PRODUCES an observation (submit a form, run a job, place a transaction)
strategies.yields: the result / receipt the action generates
strategies.governance: BOUNDARY-APPROVED — has side effects; never irreversible without explicit approval
strategies.when: the only way to get the info is to act

strategies.action: obtain a credential / key / permission to unlock a gated source
strategies.when: the source exists but is gated

strategies.action: set up a feed / watch / webhook so future changes arrive
strategies.when: the info will change or is not available yet

strategies.action: route the gap to a human (expert / reviewer / crowd)
compute a best estimate from partial signals and flag the uncertainty
strategies.governance: MUST flag as estimate, never asserted as truth
strategies.when: no source can give a definitive answer within budget
